questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

W _ A T _ W X _ _ Q _ _ A T Q

options.text: X Q A T W X
A Q A T W X
X Q A Q W X
X Q A T W A

questions.solution:
Given :- W _ A T _ W X _ _ Q _ _ A T Q

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) X Q A T W X → W **X** A T **Q** - W X **A T** Q - **W X** A T Q

 
• Here, **"WXATQ"** is repeated.

2) A Q A T W X → W **A** A T **Q** - W X **A T **Q - **W X** A T Q

3) X Q A Q W X → W **X** A T **Q** - W X **A Q** Q - **W X** A T Q

4) X Q A T W A → W **X** A T **Q** - W X **A T** Q - **W A** A T Q

 
• Option (1) gives the pattern of :- W X A T Q - W X A T Q - W X A T Q

Hence, the correct answer is **"X Q A T W X".**

questions.question:
Select the letter-cluster from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

BEC, CID, FOG, KUL, ?
questions.solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

**Logic: (1) Code = Position value of consonant + consecutive odd number(i.e. 1,3,5 etc) respectively.**

** (2) Vowel changes to next vowel in cyclic way(i.e. A → E → I → O → U).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20de8cd5896fd9c8a88917dbb23ad8b8db3555577b971da6ccd39ce3dedfd122.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"RAS".**

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that when placed from left to right in the blanks below will complete the letter series.

_HK_PQ_H_O_QJ_K_P_JH_O_Q

A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

yes, rain, alive, subtle, ?
questions.solution:
Expression: yes, rain, alive, subtle, ?

The pattern is that in each word, numbers of letters are increasing as 3, 4, 5 and 6.

Now, the next word must contain 7 letters. Among the options, the word with 7 letters is **airport**.
